contexts.text: In worship, the nature of the difference between the internal and the external man is especially discernible... Hence the difference which manifests itself in the worship; and that so clearly, that the least of the difference is noticed in Heaven.
How greatly the sense of the letter differs from the internal sense...
Hence it is that Churches differ so much...
In proportion as the state of one Society differs from that of another...
So greatly may the interior form which is of the spirit differ from the exterior form which is of the body.
When the Angels are discoursing about two truths which differ from each other...
However they may differ in truths...
Yet (these delights) differ little on the mere surface.
They who differ in dispositions and disagree in affections...
There cannot exist any true difference between the spiritual and the celestial, but only among the natural.
The Spirit at once notices the differences: that which differs is from the Spirit.
